name: Quantum computing task: Implement VQE in Qiskit for the 5-site transverse-field
task_prompt: Quantum computing task: Implement VQE in Qiskit for the 5-site transverse-field Ising model H = -J*sum(Z_i Z_{i+1}) - h*sum(X_i) with J=1.27, h=0.31 (open boundary). Use StatevectorEstimator with a TwoLocal-style ansatz and scipy, and compare with exact diagonalization. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
